statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is a 2D array (vector of vectors) of size len(rowSum) × len(colSum) such that: (1) for every i with 0 <= i < len(rowSum) and every j with 0 <= j < len(colSum), r[i][j] >= 0; (2) for every i with 0 <= i < len(rowSum), the sum of the elements of r[i] equals rowSum[i], i.e., Σ_{j=0}^{len(colSum)-1} r[i][j] = rowSum[i]; (3) for every j with 0 <= j < len(colSum), the sum of the j-th elements of all rows of r equals colSum[j], i.e., Σ_{i=0}^{len(rowSum)-1} r[i][j] = colSum[j].
preconditions: len(rowSum) >= 1, len(colSum) >= 1, len(rowSum) <= 500, len(colSum) <= 500. For every i with 0 <= i < len(rowSum), 0 <= rowSum[i] <= 10^8. For every j with 0 <= j < len(colSum), 0 <= colSum[j] <= 10^8. sum(rowSum) = sum(colSum), where sum(rowSum) = Σ_{i=0}^{len(rowSum)-1} rowSum[i] and sum(colSum) = Σ_{j=0}^{len(colSum)-1} colSum[j].
